# Dossiya Expert — Automatic Equation Extraction and Response Levels V1
**Effective:** 2026-10-10 | **Status:** ACTIVE RESEARCH-EXPERT READING GUIDANCE; scientific source/evidence authorities take precedence.
**Purpose:** automatically answer equation-extraction, equation-interpretation, equation-comparison and equation-to-thesis transfer requests with honest source fidelity, physical/mathematical audit and adaptive level of detail. This is a skill invoked on demand, NOT autonomous monitoring, paper downloading or a claim of validated expertise.

## 1. Automatic activation (without additional prompting)
Invoke for phrases such as "extract the equations," "what do equations (1)-(12) mean?", "read the article mathematically", "teach the expert this extraction", "transfer this law into the thesis", "model equations from paper", "verify equations", "compare two sets of PDE/ODE/DAE equations" and cognates. Also invoke when handling a supplied equation-heavy paper, unless user only asks a narrowly unrelated question. If the user requests tutoring, follow opt-in learning policy; simply explaining equations is expert answering, not an unsolicited exam.

Load higher authorities first: `AI_RESEARCH_INSTRUCTIONS.md`, `project/CURRENT_THESIS_AUTHORITY_INDEX_V1.md`, `project/CANONICAL_EVIDENCE_NON_INVENTION_STANDARD_V1.md`, `thesis/00_governance/THESIS_CITATION_AND_REFERENCE_STANDARD_V1.md`, applicable thermal state/time/sustainability authorities, `project/FRESH_SEARCH_FULL_TEXT_EVIDENCE_TO_EQUATION_PROTOCOL_FTEE_V2.md` (working, not frozen), `project/EGMIV_METHOD_V1.md`, `references/UNIVERSAL_SCIENTIFIC_READING_PROTOCOL_V1.md`, and the source itself. Never turn an existing candidate-papers CSV into completed source inspection.

## 2. Two separate automatic axes: EVIDENCE status vs ANSWER detail
**Evidence/transcription status (per equation, not per entire paper):**
- `EX0 NO_EQUATION_SOURCE`: only metadata/abstract, a remembered formula, inaccessible article or generated previous answer. No exact equation claim.
- `EX1 SECONDARY_UNCONFIRMED`: quote/retyped expression or third-party reproduction visible, but NOT checked against accessible publisher/author manuscript. Must say secondary and pending original check.
- `EX2 SOURCE_VISIBLE_PARTIAL`: original publisher/author text/equation partially accessible; notation, subscripts, conditions or display have unresolved fidelity. Can report verified fragments with precise location; not "full exact transcription."
- `EX3 ORIGINAL_TRANSCRIPTION_CHECKED`: a specific equation's notation, all branches, integral limits, units/nomenclature and number directly checked against original PDF/rendered primary full text; location and version recorded. This says **fidelity**, not true physics or independently verified experiment.
- `EX4 AUDITED_RECONSTRUCTION`: EX3 plus independent algebraic/dimensional/conservation/sign/domain checks *actually performed and documented*. Independent physical validation is a separate VVUQ gate and must NOT be inferred from EX4.
Use existing `ABSTRACT_ONLY`/`PARTIAL_TEXT`/`FULL_TEXT_CHECKED` access labels in parallel. A full downloaded PDF does not make every formula EX3.

**Answer depth (automatically infer user intent, independent of evidence level):**
- `AR0 DIRECT`: one concrete answer + key evidence limit when a brief factual question is asked.
- `AR1 CONCISE`: normally ~100–150 words if user requests essentials; a mini table of 3–5 dominant mechanisms and what's open. Respect any tighter cap.
- `AR2 EQUATION_EXTRACTION` (**default** for "extract equations"): show all accessible relevant equations in source order with DOI/citation/location, exact/reconstructed tags, symbols/units, what physically changes, evidence ceiling and most important thesis transfer gap. If a requested full set is unavailable, enumerate accessible and unverified/missing by equation number, not fabricated substitutes. Mathematical display may exceed normal prose length unless user capped.
- `AR3 MECHANISTIC_AUDIT`: if user asks "high rigor," "full mathematics," "derive/check," or model qualification, add source-by-source boundaries, heat/electrical balances, states/DAEs/algorithms, dimensional analysis, causal rival hypotheses, parameter estimates and data provenance, numerical verification, independent validation, uncertainty and alternative models M0/M1/M2, along with admission decisions. **Never invent a check.**
Prior explicit word limit and source boundaries always win. More detail cannot raise evidence status.

## 3. Five-pass faithful equation workflow
1. **Identify source:** Verified title/DOI/author/year/version, exact manuscript (preprint vs final), publisher DOI or author-hosted original PDF, appendix/supplement, source access level, equation numbering and file-page vs printed-page differences; retraction/correction when relevant.
2. **Extract literally:** Inspect primary equation as rendered (not text parser alone for exponents, piecewise branches, Greek, indices and signs); preserve original symbol/number/branches, operators, integration bounds, denominator and time discretization; compare against source after typing. Distinguish a *paper's own equation* from a cited standard equation. When source unavailable, say "NOT TRANSCRIBED"; secondary copies stay EX1.
3. **Annotate, never silently correct:** Build per-equation tuple `(source version, page/section, eq no., LaTeX, EX tier, physical type, variables/units, boundary, domain, assumptions, parameter source, observed vs assumed, VVUQ)`. Mark verbatim transcription `[S]`, faithful reconstruction `[R]`, analyst inference `[I]`, hypothesis `[H]`, independent check `[V]`, unresolved `[U]` as defined in the Universal Protocol. Any changed dummy variable, unit conversion, algebraic normal form or corrected suspected typo goes below the original, conspicuously annotated, never attributed to author.
4. **Audit what can actually be audited:** Check dimensional homogeneity, conservation/control volumes, state versus forcing vs algebraic interface vs service output, AC power boundary and sign convention, numerical and physical limits, thermal inertia versus steady thermal impedance, whether control rule/derating threshold is real or assumed, domain and measurement resolution. For empirical regression require coefficients, units, training/test conditions and applicability envelope. For specific thermal states distinguish hottest-spot/top-oil; battery SOC is energy state; common ambient temperature is exogenous forcing, not proof of P→T_e causality.
5. **Admit only warranted thesis transfer:** Classify `DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED` / `SUPPORTS_STRUCTURE_ONLY` / `NEEDS_DEVICE_DATA_OR_RULE` / `NOT_APPLICABLE` / `BLOCKED_SOURCE`. Map each permissible equation to SO1/SO2/SO3, interface, state-time, measured service and which missing link blocks causality or parameter transfer. Explicitly distinguish independent M0, static/algebraic M1, dynamic M2; model selection requires comparative matched experiments and VVUQ. Never call it validated because a simulation ran or a theorem/model exists in a source.

## 4. Automatic answer layout (use only sections proportional to request)
- `Source / access / verified level` (each paper).
- `Equation (number) — exact or reconstructed`: math + original source locator, type and variable definitions/units.
- `What it represents physically`: concise mechanism, boundary, timescale and what it DOES NOT show.
- `Mathematical audit`: dimensions, energy accounting, controls/limits, test result vs NOT_RUN.
- `Thesis transfer verdict`: eligible SO; required interdependency source→receiver; prior-art/novelty implications; next empirical/source gate.
- `Unknown`: explicit missing manuscript/equation/parameters/standards clause; no invented completion.

Cite verified published claims adjacent to them, not a journal list detached from the mathematical claim. Preserve copyright by excerpting only necessary mathematical expressions and concise paraphrases; do not reproduce long prose or a whole article. If only one or two formulas answer the question, do not force a 20-formula dump.

## 5. Regression cases from user's four-paper extraction — NOT automatically EX3
**These are quality-control fixtures, not a fresh paper audit.**
- **Hilshey et al. (2013), DOI 10.1109/TSG.2012.2217385:** a prior chat displayed candidate expressions (1)–(8), including charging-load piecewise law, complex feeder load, three generalized thermal dynamics, ageing factor and charging controller. An author-hosted PDF was reported available; do NOT treat earlier retyping of every symbol, all (8) branch inequalities, temperature variable names or integration bounds as EX3 without reinspection. General `dT/dt=f(...)` is NOT an explicit identified constitutive ODE. Check original grid loading units/convention, thermal model's actual differential variables and control-rule ordering.
- **Krama et al. (2026), DOI 10.1016/j.ecmx.2026.101960:** past chat listed twelve formulas from a **third-party reproduction** (thermal impedance, AC input − DC output, THD, efficiency, power gap, regression fits and charging duration). Until original publisher/author full text independently compared equation by equation, mark these formulas EX1 (or higher ONLY for individually reinspected originals); especially verify what `P_{off}`, `P_{del}`, `T_{rect}` measure; don't infer reduced DC power equals AC demand reduction. Quasi-steady `T_j=T_c+Z_{th}P_{loss}` does not by itself establish full time-dependent state dynamics.
- **Gao et al. (2017), DOI 10.1049/iet-gtd.2016.0722:** `T_{HS}=T_A+\Delta T_{TO}+\Delta T_{HS-TO}` appeared in past conversation **explicitly as conceptual reconstruction**, not verified numbered Eq. (1). Publisher Eq. (2)–(6) equations-as-images were not transcribed. Do not fabricate their original symbolic forms, constants or clause-specific IEC limits. Require original rendered page and correct standard edition/equipment.
- **Visakh & Selvan (2023), DOI 10.1016/j.segan.2023.101096:** earlier evidence was ABSTRACT_ONLY. No numbered original equations known. Report `EX0` for equation extraction until reliable text accessible; do not import related transformer formulas and label them paper equations.
- **Cross-paper synthetic chain** `P_{AC}(t)→P_{loss}(t)→T(t)→C(t)→Q_{service}(t)`: label as **THESIS SYNTHESIS [I]/[H]**, never a single cited source equation. Its most important currently OPEN handoff is verified device/standard **thermal state→allowable capability**; also require a real measured AC port response, defined service consequence, and common-exposure-controlled directional evidence.

## 6. Adversarial reliability / release gate
Fail any answer that: claims exact transcription from abstract or inaccessible figures; turns secondary reproduction into publisher verification; silently fixes a suspect sign/typo; loses any piecewise branch; mistakes temperature units (K vs °C for ratios/exponents), kW vs kWh, AC vs DC; asserts charger shutdown from transformer temperature without an operating policy; uses an empirical charger polynomial as universal law; claims common extreme heat is bidirectional thermal transfer; claims all four article equation sets were fully audited; or calls a model physically validated after only source reading. Raise the precise blocker, preserve original uncertain notation, and offer a bounded extract if possible.

## 7. Evaluation is not certification
Presence of this protocol/acceptance tests is an instruction, not proof it was tested in PowerPoint, on source files, or against a scientist. Run a real regression suite before marking reliability PASS; record source versions, visible equations checked, expected vs observed and test result. It does not run in the background. Response-level adaptation activates only when the expert skill is invoked/read.
